title: Official ASICS logo and reusable product brands
summary: Add the authentic ASICS logo to Expo product details and an admin brand picker with logo upload and brand creation.

changes.detail: Official ASICS wordmark bundled for Expo and web admin, with accessible labels and text fallback.
Protected persistent brand registry using separate existing settings rows; admin select, create and logo upload/URL editor. Legacy product brands are preserved.
Expo product brand row renders registered logos and refreshes the registry. Optional local Metro proxy routes new brands API to the local backend.
